{{< include ../_provenance.qmd >}}

```{r setup}
#| include: false
library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)
library(cowplot)
library(igraph)
library(ggraph)
library(DT)


theme_set(theme_cowplot())

targets::tar_load(supercells_hsc)
targets::tar_load(supercell_meta_hsc)

# ── Condition mapping ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
supercell_meta_hsc <- supercell_meta_hsc %>%
  dplyr::mutate(condition = dplyr::case_when(
    grepl("mCh\\+", sample) ~ "Het_mChPos",
    grepl("mCh-",   sample) ~ "Het_mChNeg",
    grepl("WT",     sample) ~ "WT",
    TRUE ~ sample
  ))

# ── Supercell graph with metadata as vertex attributes ───────────────────────
g <- supercells_hsc$graph.supercells
sc_ids <- as.integer(igraph::V(g)$name)
idx    <- match(sc_ids, supercell_meta_hsc$supercell)

igraph::V(g)$majority_cluster <- supercell_meta_hsc$majority_cluster[idx]
igraph::V(g)$sample           <- supercell_meta_hsc$sample[idx]
igraph::V(g)$condition        <- supercell_meta_hsc$condition[idx]
igraph::V(g)$size_sc          <- supercell_meta_hsc$size[idx]
igraph::V(g)$UMAP1            <- supercell_meta_hsc$UMAP1[idx]
igraph::V(g)$UMAP2            <- supercell_meta_hsc$UMAP2[idx]

layout_mat <- matrix(c(igraph::V(g)$UMAP1, igraph::V(g)$UMAP2), ncol = 2)

# ── Neighbour proportion per sample ─────────────────────────────────────────
# For each supercell, the weighted fraction of its graph neighbours that
# belong to each sample — a continuous [0,1] mixing score.
adj      <- igraph::as_adjacency_matrix(g, attr = "weight", sparse = FALSE)
row_sums <- rowSums(adj)
row_sums[row_sums == 0] <- 1
adj_norm <- adj / row_sums

samples <- sort(unique(supercell_meta_hsc$sample))
sc_sample_vec <- supercell_meta_hsc$sample[idx]   # ordered by vertex

nprop_df <- purrr::map_dfc(
  setNames(samples, paste0("nprop_", samples)),
  ~ as.numeric(adj_norm %*% (sc_sample_vec == .x))
)
nprop_df$supercell <- sc_ids

supercell_meta_hsc <- dplyr::left_join(supercell_meta_hsc, nprop_df, by = "supercell")

# ── Colour palettes ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
clusters   <- sort(unique(supercell_meta_hsc$majority_cluster))
clust_pal  <- setNames(
  scales::hue_pal()(length(clusters)),
  clusters
)

cond_pal <- c(WT = "#4DAF4A", Het_mChNeg = "#377EB8", Het_mChPos = "#E41A1C")
```

## Summary

```{r summary-table}
supercell_meta_hsc %>%
  dplyr::count(sample, condition, majority_cluster, name = "n_supercells") %>%
  dplyr::arrange(sample, majority_cluster) %>%
  DT::datatable(rownames = FALSE, filter = "top",
                options = list(pageLength = 15, scrollY = "350px",
                               scrollCollapse = TRUE))
```

```{r size-distribution, fig.height=4, fig.width=8}
ggplot(supercell_meta_hsc, aes(size, fill = condition)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 40, colour = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cond_pal) +
  facet_wrap(~ sample, nrow = 1) +
  labs(x = "Cells per supercell", y = "Count",
       title = "Supercell size distribution by sample") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        strip.text  = element_text(size = 8))
```

---

## Graph — majority cluster label

Each node is a supercell positioned at the average UMAP coordinates of its
member cells. Node size reflects supercell size. Edges connect supercells
whose member cells were adjacent in the single-cell kNN graph; edge width
is proportional to the number of shared single-cell edges.

```{r graph-cluster, fig.height=7, fig.width=9}
ggraph(g, layout = layout_mat) +
  geom_edge_link0(aes(width = weight),
                  colour = "grey75", alpha = 0.25,
                  show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_node_point(aes(fill = majority_cluster, size = size_sc),
                  shape = 21, stroke = 0.15, colour = "grey20") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = clust_pal, name = "Majority\ncluster") +
  scale_size(range = c(0.8, 5), name = "Cells\nper SC") +
  scale_edge_width(range = c(0.1, 1.5)) +
  labs(title = "SuperCell graph — HSC",
       subtitle = paste0(igraph::vcount(g), " supercells  ·  γ = 10  ·  split by sample.name")) +
  theme_void(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "right")
```

---

## Graph — sample identity

Each supercell is pure (split by sample during construction), so sample label
is a hard assignment. This panel confirms that supercells from different
samples interleave in shared transcriptional space vs. form separate islands.

```{r graph-sample, fig.height=7, fig.width=9}
sample_pal <- scales::hue_pal()(length(samples))
names(sample_pal) <- samples

ggraph(g, layout = layout_mat) +
  geom_edge_link0(aes(width = weight),
                  colour = "grey75", alpha = 0.2,
                  show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_node_point(aes(fill = sample, size = size_sc),
                  shape = 21, stroke = 0.15, colour = "grey20") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = sample_pal, name = "Sample") +
  scale_size(range = c(0.8, 5), name = "Cells\nper SC") +
  scale_edge_width(range = c(0.1, 1.5)) +
  theme_void(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "right")
```

---

## Graph — neighbour condition proportion

For each supercell the proportion of its **graph neighbours** that belong to
each sample is computed from the weighted adjacency matrix. A supercell in a
region dominated by one sample will score close to 1 for that sample and near
0 for the others — revealing where conditions are segregated vs. mixed in
transcriptional space.

```{r graph-nprop, fig.height=5, fig.width=16}
nprop_plots <- purrr::map(samples, function(s) {
  col <- paste0("nprop_", s)
  node_df <- data.frame(
    UMAP1 = igraph::V(g)$UMAP1,
    UMAP2 = igraph::V(g)$UMAP2,
    size  = igraph::V(g)$size_sc,
    prop  = supercell_meta_hsc[[col]][idx]
  )

  ggraph(g, layout = layout_mat) +
    geom_edge_link0(aes(width = weight),
                    colour = "grey80", alpha = 0.15,
                    show.legend = FALSE) +
    geom_node_point(aes(fill = node_df$prop, size = node_df$size),
                    shape = 21, stroke = 0.1, colour = "grey30") +
    scale_fill_viridis_c(name = "Neighbour\nprop.", limits = c(0, 1),
                         option = "magma") +
    scale_size(range = c(0.5, 4), guide = "none") +
    scale_edge_width(range = c(0.1, 1)) +
    labs(title = s) +
    theme_void(base_size = 10) +
    theme(legend.position = "right",
          plot.title = element_text(size = 9, hjust = 0.5))
})

patchwork::wrap_plots(nprop_plots, nrow = 1) +
  patchwork::plot_annotation(
    title = "SuperCell graph — neighbour condition proportion",
    subtitle = "Each panel: fraction of graph neighbours belonging to that sample"
  )
```

---

## Neighbour proportion distributions

```{r nprop-violin, fig.height=5, fig.width=10}
nprop_long <- supercell_meta_hsc %>%
  dplyr::select(supercell, majority_cluster, dplyr::starts_with("nprop_")) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols      = dplyr::starts_with("nprop_"),
    names_to  = "query_sample",
    values_to = "neighbour_prop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(query_sample = stringr::str_remove(query_sample, "^nprop_"))

ggplot(nprop_long, aes(majority_cluster, neighbour_prop, fill = majority_cluster)) +
  geom_violin(scale = "width", linewidth = 0.3, colour = "grey30") +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.15, outlier.size = 0.3, fill = "white",
               colour = "grey20", linewidth = 0.3) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = clust_pal, guide = "none") +
  facet_wrap(~ query_sample, nrow = 1) +
  labs(x = "Majority cluster", y = "Neighbour proportion",
       title = "Condition neighbour proportion by majority cluster") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        strip.text  = element_text(size = 8))
```

```{r cleanup}
rm(supercells_hsc, g, adj, adj_norm); gc()
```
